subject: Re: SilverLine request — SDK compatibility window & API removal timeline
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@silverline.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Devon Cho <devon.cho@silverline.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SilverLine SDK compatibility window + ask for deprecation schedule

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood runtime looks promising for our inference orchestration. We ran a quick integration spike with your hosted API and the Java and Python SDKs and hit a couple of red flags we need clarified before we commit to a production integration: 

- We rely on the Java SDK's prebuilt JNI layer for the native KV cache binding; a breaking change to the native ABI would require a rebuild in our CI. Can you confirm whether ABI-stable builds will be maintained for the next 12 months?
- Your v2 Chat API doc mentions removal of the legacy 'response_format' param in a note — do you have a formal deprecation schedule and suggested migration path? We need dates to plan engineering sprints.
- We bundle a patched requests transport in our internal client; any change to auth header semantics (e.g., moving to bearer-scope tokens per-route) will require a coordinated rollout.

Attached is a short matrix showing which SDK surface areas we use and how critical a backwards-compatible window is for us. Ideally we need a clear compatibility guarantee or a migration runway of 9–12 months for major changes.

Can you loop in platform/packaging owners and share a proposed timeline and any mitigation options (compatibility shims, dual-support windows, migration guides)?

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Integrations — SilverLine Analytics

Attachment: silverline_sdk_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@silverline.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SilverLine SDK compatibility window + ask for deprecation schedule

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear matrix and for surfacing these points. Looping in Vanessa (packaging/SDK) and Jonas (runtime) to provide concrete answers and a proposed timeline. Quick notes from my side: 

- We try to keep ABI-stable JNI builds for at least one major + 6 months for minor releases; we can discuss extending that to match your 12-month runway for the most-critical artifacts.
- The removal of response_format is planned as part of the v2 cleanup but we can publish a 9-month deprecation notice with an automated shim for the legacy param to ease migration.
- Auth semantics: we have an internal RFC to support per-route scopes later this quarter; that will be opt-in for 3 months before becoming default. We can coordinate a canary for SilverLine.

Proposed next steps:
1) Vanessa will share an SDK compatibility matrix and a proposed maintenance window for prebuilt binaries.
2) Jonas will propose a deprecation timeline for the v2 cleanup and a plan for a temporary shim.
3) I'll set up a 30-min sync for next week to review and agree on dates.

Does next Wednesday (Nov 10) 11:00 PT work for you?

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@silverline.ai>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SilverLine SDK compatibility window + ask for deprecation schedule

Hi Aisha — thanks for the matrix, it was helpful. A few concrete proposals from SDK/packaging: 

- Prebuilt native artifacts: we can publish ABI-tagged wheels/artifacts for the next 12 months for the current stable branch (stable-v3). We will maintain a glibc-2.17+ build and an alternative musl build where feasible.
- Deprecation cadence: for major removals (breaking API surface), we propose a 9-month deprecation window with the following phases: announcement -> dual-support (shim) -> forced removal. For non-breaking cleanups (renames, param normalization) a 3–6 month window.
- Migration aids: we will provide a compatibility shim package (redwood-compat) that maps legacy params to the new API for the duration of the dual-support period. We'll also publish diff-style migration guides and automated linting scripts for common callsites.

Attached: requested_schema_examples.json (two example payloads showing response_format -> media_type mapping).

Action items for us:
- We will publish a formal compatibility matrix and an enforcement timeline by Nov 12.
- Offer a 30-day early access channel (nuget/pip nightly) for SilverLine to test prebuilt artifacts as we cut them.

If those items address your principal concerns, we'll confirm dates in the sync.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, SDK & Packaging
Redwood Inference

Attachment: requested_schema_examples.json (JSON examples, 5 KB)

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@silverline.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Devon Cho <devon.cho@silverline.ai>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SilverLine SDK compatibility window + ask for deprecation schedule

Hannah / Vanessa — this looks good and much more concrete than we expected. Nov 10 works for the sync; we'll invite our engineering lead (Devon) to the call. Two quick asks before the meeting: 

1) Can you include a proposed date for the start of the 9-month deprecation window for the 'response_format' removal in the Nov 12 artifact? We need that to map to our Q2 roadmap.
2) Can you grant us access to the early-access pip wheel repo for stable-v3 nightly artifacts so our CI can exercise the prebuilt JNI layer?

If you can confirm those two items in the doc on Nov 12 we'll be able to commit to a pilot in Q1. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Best regards,
Aisha Patel
Head of Integrations — SilverLine Analytics
